step1.title: Electronic invoicing reform: be ready for September 1, 2026

reform.title: Reform support
reform.description: Electronic invoice exchanges will be progressively generalized from September 2026. We are anticipating the reform now to guarantee your compliance and ensure the continuation of our missions.
reform.listIntroBold: To receive and issue compliant invoices,
reform.listItem1: quality improvement of your supplier repositories
reform.listItem2: a comprehensive report identifying non-compliant sales invoice data, to be brought into compliance by September 2027
reform.listItem4: answers to all your questions about electronic invoicing, until September 30, 2026

pennylane.title: Pennylane
pennylane.descriptionPart1: To make this reform an opportunity to optimize your management experience and improve collaboration,
pennylane.descriptionBold: RYDGE Conseil has chosen to use the Approved Pennylane Platform,
pennylane.descriptionPart2: in order to centralize your finances, automate your accounting management tasks and save precious time on a daily basis.

step2.title: 1/3 Your support towards the reform
step2.reformDescription: The electronic invoicing reform (EIR) requires a mandatory upgrade for every company. It involves the control and compliance of data as well as the activation of the Pennylane platform. The subscription amount varies according to your company's needs.

supportNotice.title: Need help?
supportNotice.description: For any questions, please contact your usual contact person or the customer relations department (accompagnement{'@'}rydge.fr)
supportNotice.descriptionDelayed: Your access to Pennylane will be activated between mid-June and end of July 2026, after your accounting data is made available. You will be notified by email.

risks.title: What are the risks if you don't anticipate this reform?
risks.item1: No longer being able to invoice your clients

pennylane.title: Why Pennylane?
pennylane.item1Bold: A solution compliant with electronic invoicing
pennylane.item2: that brings together your accounting, financial management, your business account and your Approved Platform.

compliance.title: Why a support package?
compliance.item1: – Without updating your repositories, you will no longer be able to issue or receive valid invoices.
compliance.item2: – We identify non-compliant data and protect you against fraud.
compliance.item3: – We guide you towards a smooth and secure adoption of the Approved Platform.
